name: Wells Fargo Autograph Card

sources.label: Wells Fargo Autograph Visa application terms

reviewNotes: The legal product name is Wells Fargo Autograph Visa Card. Wells Fargo's current card marketplace provides an active application path and lists no annual fee; a recent independent review corroborates availability and the fee. The welcome offer, uncapped 3X earning categories, transfer partners, cellular telephone protection, and other insurance/protection features are excluded by the recurring-benefit rules. Global synchronization disposition: create card:wells-fargo-autograph; there are no benefit definitions, existing-card statuses, or Benefit Usage Guide links to propagate. Card art is served by Visa's product-card image host and recorded in docs/card-image-sources.md.
